bullets_zh: NeuroTechX于2026-09-14发布MOABB v1.7.2。
该版本通过TRCA和TRCSP使用gmean修复pyRiemann均值API兼容性。
新增TRCSP指标与TRCA协方差处理的回归测试覆盖。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX released MOABB v1.7.2 on 2026-09-14.
It fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs by using gmean in TRCA and TRCSP.
The release adds regression coverage for TRCSP metrics and TRCA covariance handling.
items.brief: MOABB 1.7.2修复pyRiemann兼容，提升EEG-BCI基准评测稳定性。
items.brief_en: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility and improves non-invasive EEG-BCI benchmark evaluation.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means.
